execution.training_method: fake quantization with identity straight-through gradients
limitations: Dense, embedding, normalization, nonlinearities, softmax, and gradient kernels use floating point.
Master parameters and optimizer states stay floating point; estimated code bytes are not measured training-memory savings.
Chromatic uniform palettes relabel the same scalar levels as equal-bit uniform integer quantization.
Straight-through gradients approximate discrete assignment, rounding, and clipping.

non_claims: This fixed MNIST MLP experiment does not establish general accuracy or speed gains.
Chroma8 QAT retains FP32 masters and kernels, plus RGB symbols and FP64 range metadata.
Earlier repository experiments used the official MNIST test split. This procedure withholds it until all new training checkpoints are fixed.
